Manage application names and ports

This silent browser recording uses two disposable accounts and real applications in an isolated acceptance environment. It shows the implemented interface, without exposing a live user's files or credentials.

  1. Open Admin overview → Applications and find the owner and app.
  2. Change the user's single name limit from 8 to 12.
  3. Change the No Internet app port from 8000 to 8001.
  4. Disable and re-enable the named URL.
  5. Set the limit to zero: the existing URL remains available; registering a new name is refused.
  6. Restore the limit to 8 and remove the demonstration mapping.

Limits count names across both environments. URL controls preserve files and running processes. Administrators manage mappings without gaining access to another user's app contents.
